mapper.select: SELECT id, slug, school_name, short_name, logo_url, banner_url, primary_color, school_domain, timezone, status, created_at, updated_at FROM schools WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, slug, school_name, short_name, logo_url, banner_url, primary_color, school_domain, timezone, status, created_at, updated_at FROM schools WHERE slug = #{slug}
SELECT id, slug, school_name, short_name, logo_url, banner_url, primary_color, school_domain, timezone, status, created_at, updated_at FROM schools WHERE status = 'active' ORDER BY school_name ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schools (slug, school_name, short_name, logo_url, banner_url, primary_color, school_domain, timezone, status) VALUES (#{slug}, #{schoolName}, #{shortName}, #{logoUrl}, #{bannerUrl}, #{primaryColor}, #{schoolDomain}, #{timezone}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE schools SET school_name = #{schoolName}, short_name = #{shortName}, logo_url = #{logoUrl}, banner_url = #{bannerUrl}, primary_color = #{primaryColor}, school_domain = #{schoolDomain}, timezone = #{timezone}, status = #{status} WHERE slug = #{slug}
